name: raftkit
description: RaftLabs' private plugin marketplace — the RaftLabs way of shipping software, packaged for Claude Code and Claude apps.

plugins.name: raftkit-core
plugins.description: RaftKit rules (Asana constants, the one human stop per run, fetch-once live reads, Asana HTML, free tier, scope line, escalation, readiness, plain output), the RaftLabs working agreement and Module Design Standard, and usage telemetry hooks.

plugins.name: raftkit-pm
plugins.description: PM skills: onboarding, brainstorming an idea into a spec doc, user stories, story skill generator, story readiness, status updates, meeting decisions, estimation, deprecation sweep.

plugins.name: raftkit-dev
plugins.description: Developer skills: repo init, ultrathink planning, implementation, scope guard, simplification, PRs, bug and incident fixes, UI creation, project setup, recipes, capability preflight, the full docs product, generalized Hasura migrations, and an opt-in CI auto-fix workflow for Critical PR findings.

plugins.name: raftkit-qa
plugins.description: QA skills: test suites, test run sheets, bug filing, retest.
